title: Upheld Disputes and the Repayment Plan Down Payment — Network Participation Agreements
content:
A practice under the **Network Participation Agreements** that has recently lost disputes in full pays a larger down payment when it places an agreement's overpayments in a repayment plan.

**Clause.** The down payment dispute-history points are set by the agreement's dispute decisions that upheld an overpayment in full and are dated fewer than 24 whole months before today:

- two or more add 20 percentage points to the down payment percentage;
- exactly one adds 10 percentage points;
- none adds nothing.

The down payment percentage is the percentage at which the down payment base is taken.

## Which decisions count

- Only decisions whose outcome upheld the overpayment in full count. A reduced or withdrawn outcome does not.
- The resolved date must be fewer than 24 whole months before today.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the resolved date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the resolved date's day of the month.

## Truth table (hypothetical)

| Upheld-in-full decisions in the window | Other decisions in the window | Percentage points added |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2 reduced | Nothing |
| 1 | 1 withdrawn | 10 |
| 2 | 0 | 20 |
| 3 | 0 | 20 |
